reviews.review:
This game is like you threw high-tech space travelling civilization and the twilight zone together. There's so much mystery. This is continued in Risk of Rain 2. The thing is, the two games on many levels drastically differ. So what makes these two games deserving of the same branding? This is where the core mechanics come into play: The game revolves around a constant flow of ever increasing difficulty, and RNG every single run. This is one reason this game made such a smooth transition from 2D to 3D. It doesn't matter how exactly the game plays. The core mechanics and ideas remain. Risk of Rain 1 is a great game for this alone.

As for this game, it's in my opinion actually harder than its sequel. There's not really any way to just run away from enemies. You often must face them. I also suspect the time tables are shorter. Many of the characters and move sets will be familiar to players coming from the 2nd title, albeit in 2D form. A number of the sequels musical tracks made their debut here in this humble title. Chris is a fantastic musician. Every title his music is in is worth the price alone.

Overall, great title, is the OG title, but it might depend on your preferred style of gameplay whether you like this one. I found it more hardcore myself. I may be biased as the 2nd game was my starter.
I have played for 1.4 hours and have already fought 8 Magma Worms in my 5 runs.

very very fun, if you like the second one this is a nice change of pace but please dont buy it for the multiplayer, This is a single player game and if you want to play with friends install mods through Rainfusion. The modding community is great and the mods improve the multiplayer and add tons of new stuff. 

In the end dont expect the quality of the Risk of Rain 2 but it still is one of my favorite games out their
